en|98e679962774589d.en: The object of the procurement is a framework contract arrangement for shop inspection, repair, and engine testing services for the Pratt & Whitney and Rolls-Royce gas generators utilized at the reserve power plants owned and operated by Fingrid Oyj in Finland.

fi|9832b7bcccc35332.en: DYNAMISING THE CONTRACTING SYSTEM This dynamic purchasing system (DPS) targets telecommunications services to customers of Hansel Oy. fi|9832b7bcccc35332.sv: DYNAMISING THE CONTRACTING SYSTEM Detta dynamiska inköpssystem (DPS) riktar sig till telekommunikationstjänster till kunder i Hansel Oy.
